meta.title: United Flowers | Vegetable Oils, Ghee & Bakery Fats, Made in Jeddah
meta.description: United Flowers refines and packs cooking oils, ghee, margarine and bakery fats in Jeddah for homes, bakeries, HoReCa and food manufacturers across Saudi Arabia and the MENA region.

home.eyebrow: Oils · Ghee · Margarine · Made in Jeddah
home.heroSub: Vegetable oils, ghee and bakery fats from our factory in Jeddah, for homes, bakeries and kitchens across Saudi Arabia and the region.
home.storyIntro: Every drop starts with a sunflower.
home.storyIntroSub: Follow it from the field to your kitchen.
home.ch1Body: It starts with good raw materials: sunflower, corn, canola, soybean, palm and olive. Chosen for quality, stability and taste.
home.ch2Body: In our factory in Jeddah Industrial City, every batch is refined, bleached and deodorised, then filled and packed under strict hygiene and quality controls.
home.ch3Body: From a 250 ml bottle for the home to 25 kg blocks for bakeries and 20 L jerry cans for restaurants, one factory covers every size.
home.ch4Body: Our brands reach shops, bakeries and kitchens across Saudi Arabia, the GCC, the wider MENA region and the Levant.
home.solTitle: Built for the way you work.
home.plBody: We produce oils, ghee and margarine under your name, from formulation to packed pallet. Customers are partners at United Flowers.
home.eventsTitle: See us at the region's food shows.
home.eventsBody: United Flowers exhibits at The Saudi Food Show and regional trade events. Come and taste the range at our stand.
home.ctaBody: Distributors, bakeries, restaurants, retailers and importers: tell us what you need and our team will get back to you.

solutions.title: The right fat for every kitchen.
solutions.sub: Choose your business and see the products, pack sizes and support we offer.
solutions.bakeryBody: Croissant sheets, pastry margarine, butter blends and pure butter that laminate cleanly and bake golden.

solutions.retailBody: Shelf-ready consumer brands in bottles, tins and cartons, with reliable supply for supermarkets and wholesalers.
solutions.industryBody: RBD oils and specialty fats in bulk formats for food manufacturers, with consistent specs batch after batch.

about.title: From the sunflower to the Saudi kitchen.
about.sub: United Flowers was founded in Jeddah to make vegetable oils and fats that families and bakers can trust.
about.story: From our factory in Jeddah Industrial City we refine, fill and pack a full range of cooking oils, ghee and margarine, sold under our own brands and made to order as private label. Our factory is equipped with modern technology and run by an experienced team that follows all health regulations and strict quality standards. Today we are growing into processed cheese and sauces.
about.mission: To keep adding value to society through healthy products, in quality, price and delivery, and to promote a healthy lifestyle.
about.vision: To build a strong, trusted identity by producing and distributing healthy oils and fats across the MENA region.

values.d: We do business with transparency and integrity.
Strict health standards and customer satisfaction.
Dedication and achievement in everything we do.
We earn trust by respecting our people, clients and partners.

about.quality: We are committed to producing and delivering safe, legal products with consistent quality, meeting our customers' expectations through continuous improvement of our systems.
